relationships.direction_semantics: The application component runs on the node (it is deployed there, in a named environment).
relationships.source_reference: plan row S33 — ArchiMate 3.2 application–technology relationship: Node realization Application Component; the deployment pattern Artifact realization Application Component, Node assignment Artifact — Archi's implementation of the ArchiMate 3.2 relationship tables (relationships.xml, version 3.2, read 2026-11-02). B1 review, owner's decision 2026-11-02.
relationships.confidence_basis: standard relationship checked against the ArchiMate 3.2 relationship tables as implemented by Archi
relationships.reasoning: ArchiMate 3.2 lets a Node realise an Application Component — the component runs on it — through the Artifact deployed to it (Artifact realises the component; the Node is assigned the Artifact). DEPLOYED_ON names that hosting. It is limited to the ArchiMate types that host software (Node, Device, System Software): a Technology Service or Interface only serves an application, and a network or path carries traffic, so neither is 'deployed on' (B1 review, 2026-11-02).
